name: check_event_registration
description: Check whether a participant is registered in the requested CSV, then return their separate approval status, reason, and gate note. Always call this for questions like 'is participant X registered, check sheet_name.csv'.

input_binding.participant_lookup: Let the agent decide from the caller's participant name, registration ID, email, or phone
input_binding.sheet_name: Let the agent decide from the spoken CSV filename; default to sarvam_epoch_registration_tracker.csv

response_template: CSV lookup result: sheet_found={{sheet_found}}; sheet_name={{sheet_name}}; found={{found}}; registered={{registered}}; approval_status={{approval_status}}; verdict={{verdict}}; reason={{reason}}; gate_note={{gate_note}}.
